questions.description: Enter a unique name for the widget

queries.postgres: INSERT INTO widget (widgetname, widgettitle, widgetversion, widgetby, description, recordstatus, moduleid) VALUES ($1, $2, '1.0.0', 'AI Assistant', $3, 1, 1) RETURNING widgetid
queries.sqlserver: INSERT INTO widget (widgetname, widgettitle, widgetversion, widgetby, description, recordstatus, moduleid) VALUES (?, ?, '1.0.0', 'AI Assistant', ?, 1, 1); SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY();
queries.oracle: INSERT INTO widget (widgetname, widgettitle, widgetversion, widgetby, description, recordstatus, moduleid) VALUES (:1, :2, '1.0.0', 'AI Assistant', :3, 1, 1) RETURNING widgetid INTO :4
queries.sqlite: INSERT INTO widget (widgetname, widgettitle, widgetversion, widgetby, description, recordstatus, moduleid) VALUES (?, ?, '1.0.0', 'AI Assistant', ?, 1, 1)
queries.mysql: INSERT INTO widget (widgetname, widgettitle, widgetversion, widgetby, description, recordstatus, moduleid) VALUES (?, ?, '1.0.0', 'AI Assistant', ?, 1, 1)

list_queries.mysql: SELECT widgetid, widgetname, widgettitle FROM widget WHERE recordstatus = 1 ORDER BY widgetname LIMIT 20
list_queries.sqlserver: SELECT TOP 20 widgetid, widgetname, widgettitle FROM widget WHERE recordstatus = 1 ORDER BY widgetname
